line.comment: * Called from the Mayhem.Monitor.Missions.xml on a periodic basis.
* Generates up to 2 missions in a sector.
* Get compatible stations.
* Count existing missions and collect stations that can receive a new mission.
* Add-Ons 1.3: Prevent the same mission type from appearing twice in the same sector.
* No station is available for another mission.
* Add-Ons 2.1.3: Roll the desired total number of missions in this sector.
* Existing missions are never removed if the rolled target is lower. Variable RNG upper bounds are exclusive, so use max+1 to roll 0-2.
* Sector already meets or exceeds this generation cycle's target.
* Add-Ons 1.4.3a: No missions in a sector whose owner has a permanent war with the player.
* Ship missions and missions requiring docking require non-negative relations.
* trade2, trade3, fight3, other4, other5: Acquisition, Delivery, Bait, Rescue, Police.
* Other restricted missions: provision (trade1), collection (other2), VIP (other6), supplies (trade4)
* Expanded 2.2: Retrieve predetermined mission entries for the faction that owns this sector.
* Expanded 2.2: Prevent concurrent mission generation from modifying the same race's cache.
* Another generation task is already handling this race.
* Acquire the race-specific lock.
* Examine only entries already present at the start of this generation pass.
* Debug counters.
* Create missions until the sector target is reached,
* there are no available stations, or all original
* cached entries have been examined.
* Take the oldest predetermined entry.
* Discard invalid entries.
* Prevent duplicate mission types in the same sector.
* Restricted missions require non-negative relations.
* Select an unused compatible station.
* Defensive check in case another process assigned a mission after our initial station scan.
* The cached entry itself was not attempted. Preserve it for a future generation pass.
* Attempt to create the actual mission using its predetermined name and difficulty.
* Discard the entry if mission creation fails.
* Mission successfully generated.
* Remove the occupied station from our available pool.
* Replenish after processing the original cached entries.
* Newly generated entries are not used during this pass.
* Stop if entry generation unexpectedly fails.
* Store the updated cache.
* Optional debug logging.
* Expanded 2.2: Release the race-specific generation lock.
